notes: All PNG layers use the exact 894x839 source canvas.
Visible skull artwork is directly extracted from the original source without resizing or repositioning.
No hair, beard, ponytail or other clear secondary-motion part was separated.
The white/gold cleric robe, shoulders, collar, torso and hands remain in the static body layer.
A narrow hidden robe/neck region behind the skull was reconstructed only to support subtle head translation and rotation.
eyes_closed.png is a full-canvas transparent blink overlay that replaces the glowing sockets with darker resting sockets.
Normalized pivot coordinates use x=0 left, x=1 right, y=0 bottom, y=1 top.
